description:
Read one webhook endpoint

Returns a single registered endpoint, wrapped in a `data` object. The signing secret is not included and cannot be recovered here or anywhere else. Note `isActive` together with `failedDeliveries`: an endpoint is disabled automatically once 25 consecutive deliveries have failed, and a single successful delivery resets that counter to zero.

id.description: Identifier of the endpoint. A non-numeric value is rejected with 400.
